articles.headline: Connelly: How Week 10's top games were won, what it means for CFP
articles.description: From Notre Dame's CJ Carr to Alabama's consistency, we examine the keys to victory on a statement Saturday.

images.name: Keelon Russell [608x342]
images.caption: Keelon Russell and Alabama pretty much did whatever they wanted against LSU.

images.caption: Micah Gilbert was a favorite target of CJ Carr's, with nine catches for 98 yards.

images.name: Bo Jackson [608x342]

articles.headline: Michigan fires offensive coordinator Jason Beck after loss to Michigan State
articles.description: A day after losing to rival Michigan State 15-6, Michigan fired offensive coordinator Jason Beck, the program announced Sunday afternoon. The Wolverines are 5-4 and have the No. 17 scoring offense in the Big Ten.

articles.headline: Army honors the Ivy Soldiers with special camouflage uniforms against Navy
articles.description: Army's uniforms against Navy will pay tribute to the legacy of the 4th Infantry Division.

images.name: army navy uniforms [608x342]
images.caption: Army unveiled its uniforms on Sunday for its annual game against Navy.

images.name: army ball vs navy [608x342]

article.story: MIAMI -- — Devonte Lyons ran for a career-high 216 yards and two touchdowns, and Robert Czeremcha kicked a 42-yard field goal late in the game to give Florida International a 20-17 victory over Missouri State on Saturday night. Lyons scored on a 17-yard run early in the fourth quarter that stretched the FIU lead to 17-6. After a Yousef Obeid 22-yard field goal for Missouri State, J.J. O'Neal forced a fumble near midfield and Jashawn Cooper returned the ball into the end zone for the Bears that tied the game at 17-all with 6:42 left to play. Czeremcha kicked the game-winner with 1:55 remaining, capping a 10-play, 54-yard drive. Henry Belin IV drove the Bears to the FIU 22 with 21 seconds left, but was called for intentional grounding on third down to end it. Lyons had 24 carries that included a 56-yard run and a short-yardage score. JJ Kohl threw for 183 yards and an interception for FlU (4-5, 2/3 Conference USA), which ended a three-game skid. Belin threw for 225 yards for Missouri State (3-6, 2-2). Up next Missouri State: at home against New Mexico State next Saturday. FIU: at Delaware next Saturday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college football coverage here
